title: Fairness Verification — lasso classifier, twelve tests, no collapsed PASS; 'opportunity → fair service → verified progress'

source.source_reference: Shawn's explicit teaching, main chat, 2026-10-10. Filed same-evening per his standing law: his word IS the verification (Verification Law); filed immediately, not queued.

intelligence.essence: Every liveness qualification must prove three links: opportunity → fair service → verified progress (or a governed resolution). The lasso classifier names infinite execution shapes so the model checker can't hand-wave them; twelve discriminating tests separate real fairness from passing-by-luck; the canonical trace format makes every verdict re-checkable; the refinement proof connects the model to the implementation. No collapsed PASS: a single green verdict that hides which links were actually exercised is forbidden — the report must show each link's evidence. This is the methodology layer; it doesn't assume the scheduler is fair, it proves it link by link.

human_view.meaning: Don't just say 'the scheduler is fair.' Prove three things separately: the work got its chance, the chance was actually fair, and the fair chance actually accomplished something. One thumbs-up that hides the details is not allowed.
human_view.why_it_matters: This is where fairness claims become checkable. Without it, 'verified fair' is a slogan.

simple_view.meaning: Don't just say 'the scheduler is fair.' Prove three things separately: the work got its chance, the chance was actually fair, and the fair chance actually accomplished something. One thumbs-up that hides the details is not allowed.

naya_view.directive: Prove the three links separately with the lasso classifier and the twelve tests. Emit the canonical trace for every verdict. Forbid collapsed PASS verdicts — each link shows its evidence or the qualification fails. Connect model to implementation with the refinement proof.

ai_view.specification: verify(scheduler) = prove(opportunity) ∧ prove(fair_service) ∧ prove(progress ∨ governed_resolution); each with evidence; verdict format = canonical trace; collapsed PASS rejected.
ai_view.directive: Follow as written. This is law, not guidance.
